title: Flatness of the local affine tensor coefficient map
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative R-algebras and qprime a prime of C=A tensor_R B. Let Rp,Aq,Bp,D be localizations at the contracted primes and qprime, respectively, with the canonical scalar towers and structure maps specified as in lem-pc-affine-tensor-cohomology-localization-isos. A ring homomorphism f:Aq tensor_Rp Bp to D agreeing with the prescribed Aq and Bp structure maps is flat. This assertion needs no complex or cohomology lift.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8, affine displayed localization identity; Tags 00DL, 00CS, 06Y6

proof.text: Set C = A tensor_R B, T0 = Aq tensor_R B, and T1 = Aq tensor_R Bp. IsLocalization.algebraTensorEquiv identifies Aq tensor_Rp Bp with T1, using the localization Rp of R. Transport f along its inverse to g:T1 to D. On pure tensors this inverse is the identity.

Define i:C to T0 and j:T0 to T1 by the structure maps on the localized factors. The hypotheses hfA, hfB, hB and the scalar towers show g(j(i(a tensor b))) = algebraMap(C,D)(a tensor b): write a tensor b as the product of the two factor inclusions, then use multiplicativity. Tensor induction gives equality on all C. This supplies the scalar tower C,T0,D.

IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct makes T0 the localization of C at the image of the complement of the contracted A-prime. This image is contained in the complement of qprime by the definition of contraction. IsLocalization.isLocalization_of_submonoid_le therefore makes D a localization of T0. IsLocalization.flat gives flatness of D over T0.

IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right makes j:T0 to T1 the localization at the image of the complement of the contracted B-prime. Module.flat_iff_of_isLocalization transfers the flatness of D over T0 to flatness over T1 for its prescribed g-action. RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff converts this to g.Flat. RingHom.Flat.comp_iff_of_bijective_right, applied to the inverse tensor equivalence from the first step, yields f.Flat.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0DJ8, 00DL, 00CS: successive factor localization, prescribed-map compatibility, localization flatness, and transport through the localized-base tensor equivalence; complete Lean proof by G2

lean.statement:
theorem affineTensorLocalization_flat
    (R A B : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (q' : PrimeSpectrum (A ⊗[R] B))
        (Rp Aq Bp D : Type u) [CommRing Rp] [CommRing Aq] [CommRing Bp] [CommRing D]
        [Algebra R Rp] [Algebra A Aq] [Algebra B Bp] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Rp (q'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R (A ⊗[R] B)))]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Aq (q'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime Bp (q'.asIdeal.comap
          Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom)]
        [IsLocalization.AtPrime D q'.asIdeal]
        [Algebra R Aq] [Algebra R Bp] [Algebra Rp Aq] [Algebra Rp Bp]
        [IsScalarTower R A Aq] [IsScalarTower R B Bp]
        [IsScalarTower R Rp Aq] [IsScalarTower R Rp Bp]
        [Algebra A D] [Algebra B D] [Algebra Aq D] [Algebra Bp D]
        [IsScalarTower A (A ⊗[R] B) D]
        [IsScalarTower A Aq D]
        (_hB : ∀ b : B, algebraMap B D b =
          algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b))
        [IsScalarTower B Bp D]
        (f : (Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) →+* D)
        (_hfA : ∀ a : Aq,
          f (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := Rp) a : Aq ⊗[Rp] Bp) = algebraMap Aq D a)
        (_hfB : ∀ b : Bp, f (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight b) = algebraMap Bp D b)
    : f.Flat
